name: moebius_multiple_factor325
math: For all q and n, mu of q times n equals mu q times the Mobius coefficient restricted to indices coprime to q. The common prime case vanishes.

name: moebius_multiples_reciprocal_bound325
math: For positive q, the absolute reciprocal Mobius sum at q times each integer from one through N is at most inverse q.

name: moebius_multiples_reindex325
math: For positive q, the reciprocal Mobius sum through M restricted to multiples of q equals the sum indexed by integers from one through M divided by q of mu of q n over q n.

name: resonant_mobius_reciprocal_bound325
math: For positive q, the absolute reciprocal Mobius sum through M restricted to multiples of q is at most inverse q.

name: odd_moebius_multiples_reciprocal_bound325
math: For positive q, the reciprocal Mobius sum at q times the odd integers through N has absolute value at most inverse q.
